```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggdiagram)
temple <- list(
  cherry = "#a41e35",
  gold   = "#AD7422",
  gray   = "#9E9597",
  black  = "#222222",
  yellow = "#fecb00",
  skies  = "#ceecf9",
  nook   = "#FFF2E8",
  silver = "#C1C6C8",
  metallic = "#8a8d8f",
  taupe = "#bca685",
  lime = "#c7d733",
  eggshell = "#f2eee8",
  ochre = "#fcb813",
  darkblue = "#2e297b",
  geranium = "#e82c2a"
)
my_font <- "Roboto Condensed"
my_fills <- class_color(
  viridis::viridis(3, begin = .2, end = .7),
  saturation = .5,
  brightness = .75
)@darken(.2)

# Diagram helpers
lb   <- redefault(ob_label, size = 15, fill = NA, color = "white", lineheight = 1)
plb  <- redefault(ob_label, size = 14, fill = "white", color = "black")
# Diagram defaults
node <- redefault(ob_ellipse, m1 = 15, color = NA, fill = temple$cherry)
node_lb <- redefault(ob_label, size = 13, fill = NA, color = "white")
path <- redefault(connect, resect = 2, label_sloped = FALSE, 
                  linewidth = .75)
path_lb <- redefault(ob_label, size = 13, fill = "white", color = temple$black)

covariance <- redefault(connect, arc_bend = .6, arrow_fins = arrowhead(), resect = 2, linewidth = .75)

latent <- redefault(ob_circle, color = NA, fill = "dodgerblue4")
latent_lb <- redefault(ob_label, color = "white", fill = NA, size = 16)
# ggdiagram::set_default_arrowhead(arrowheadr::arrowheads$spade)



```

```{r}
#| label: fig-lgc
#| fig-cap: Polynomial Growth Curve Model
#| fig-width: 6.5

ggdiagram(font_family = my_font, font_size = 15) +
  {
    # Indicators
    y <- ob_ellipse(m1 = 15, a = .8, color = NA) |>
      ob_array(
        6,
        sep = .2,
        fill = paste0("gray", c(65, 60, 55, 50, 45, 40)),
        label = lb(paste0(
          "Reading<br>Grade ", c("K", 1:5)
        ))
      )
  } +
  {
    # latent variables
    lv <- ob_circle(
      radius = 1.1,
      fill = c(temple$cherry, temple$gold, temple$darkblue),
      color = NA,
      label = lb(c("Initial<br>Status", "Growth<br>Rate", "Acceleration<br>Rate"))
    ) |> place(bind(c(y[1:2]@bounding_box, y[3:4]@bounding_box, y[5:6]@bounding_box)), where = "above", sep = 6)
  } +
  {
    # Inital Status Loadings
    li <- connect(
      lv[1],
      y,
      resect = 2,
      color = temple$cherry,
      label_sloped = FALSE
    )
  } +
  {
    # Growth Loadings
    lg <- connect(
      lv[2],
      y[seq(length(y), 1L)],
      resect = 2,
      color = temple$gold,
      label_sloped = FALSE
    )
  } +
  {
    # Acceleration Loadings
    la <- connect(
      lv[3],
      y[seq(length(y), 1L)],
      resect = 2,
      color = temple$darkblue,
      label_sloped = FALSE
    )
  } +
  plb(center = intersection(lg, lv[2] |> set_props(radius = 1.875)), label = as.character(seq(length(li), 1) - 1L), color = temple$gold) +
  # Growth Rate Loading Labels
  plb(
    center = intersection(la, connect(lv[2], place(ob_ellipse(m1 = 15, a = .8, color = NA), from = y[6], where = "right",sep = .25))),
    label = as.character((seq(length(li), 1) - 1L) ^ 2),
    color = temple$darkblue
  ) +
  # Initial Status Loading Labels
  plb(
    center = intersection(li, connect(lv[2], place(ob_ellipse(m1 = 15, a = .8, color = NA), from = y[1], where = "left",sep = .25))),
    label = rep("1", length(li)),
    color = temple$cherry
  ) +
  # Covariance
  connect(
    lv[c(1,1, 2)],
    lv[c(2,3, 3)],
    arc_bend = -.8,
    arrow_fins = arrowhead(),
    resect = 2
  ) +
  # Indicator Variances
  ob_variance(y,
              where = "south",
              color = y@fill, 
              theta = degree(45),
              looseness = 1.1,
              bend = -15) +
  # Latent Variances
  ob_variance(lv, 
              where = "north", 
              theta = degree(32.5),
              looseness = .85,
              bend = -5,
              color = temple[c("cherry", "gold", "darkblue")])
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-cfa
#| fig-cap: Confirmatory Factor Analysis
ggdiagram(font_family = my_font) +
  {
    o <- latent(center = ob_polar(degree(c(90, 210, 330)), r = 2), 
            fill = temple[c("cherry", "gold", "darkblue")],
            label = node_lb(
              c(
                "Reading<br>Decoding",
                "Language<br>Comprehension",
                "Reading<br>Comprehension"
              ),
              size = 12
            ),
            id = c("RD", "LC", "RC"))
  } +
  map_ob(o, \(oo) {
    a <- ob_array(node(ob_polar(oo@center@theta, r = 4.6), 
                     a = .5, 
                     angle = oo@center@theta,
                     fill = oo@fill),
                  k = 3, 
                  sep = .2, 
                  where = oo@center@theta + turn(.25),
                  label = node_lb(subscript(oo@id, 1:3), angle = (oo@center@theta + turn(.25))@upright, nudge_y = -.05, nudge_x = .01))
    list(a, connect(oo, a, resect = 2))
  }) + covariance(o[c(1, 2, 3)], o[c(2, 3, 1)]) 
```

```{r}
# Number of ellipses
k <- 12

# Colors
e_fills <- hsv(h = seq(0, 1 - 1 / k, length.out = k), 
               s = .4, 
               v = .6)

ggdiagram(my_font) +
  {e_0 <- ob_ellipse(m1 = 6, 
                 label = ob_label("*A*", 
                               size = 45, 
                               color = "white", 
                               fill = "gray20"),
                 color = NA,
                 fill = "gray20")} + 
  {e_x <- place(
    x = ob_ellipse(a = .4, 
                b = .4, 
                m1 = 6, 
                label = ob_label(paste0("*a*~", seq(k), "~"), 
                              color = "white", 
                              fill = e_fills,
                              size = 18),
                color = NA,
                fill = e_fills),
    from = e_0,
    where = degree(seq(0, 360 - 360 / k, 360 / k)),
    sep = .85
  )} +
  connect(e_0, 
          e_x, 
          resect = 2, 
          color = e_fills) +
  purrr::map(unbind(e_x), \(e) {
    exx <- ob_ellipse(color = NA, fill = e@fill, a = .15, b = .15, m1 = 6) %>% 
      place(from = e_0,
            where = degree(e@center@theta) + degree(c(-10, 0, 10)),
            sep = 2.35)
    list(as.geom(exx),
         as.geom(connect(e, exx, color = e@fill, resect = 1, length_head = 6)))}) 
```
